head: Adobe Premiere's AI Assistant now uses your Firefly credits
dek: Adobe removed the daily and weekly free limits on Premiere's AI Assistant; instead, every reply now uses Firefly credits from your Adobe plan. A credits icon under each answer shows what it cost.
details: Adobe says there's no way to see the cost before you ask, because it depends on your project and the tools the Assistant uses. When you run low, Premiere shows a notice and lets you buy more credits. Users on Adobe's forum say even simple questions use credits.
where: Adobe Premiere, plans with Firefly credits
means: Chatting with the Assistant now spends the same credits you use for generative features.
todo: Hover over the credits icon under a reply to see what it used, and ask simple how-to questions in Adobe's help pages instead.
